text: Awesome beach towel!. Bought for birthday present. Nice towel! Great value!

product_metadata.title: A·M CAT Turkish Beach Towel (67" x 36") Oversized Clearance Large Blanket 100% Cotton - Prewashed, Sand Free, Quick Dry, Super Soft - for Bath, Beach, Pool, SPA, Gym (Aquamarine)
features: ◀High Quality▶A·M Cat sand free beach towels are made of 100% Pure Cotton, the towels have been prewashed to allow the cotton fibers to bloom and expand, kick starting its absorbency. So our large beach towel has soft feeling, lightness, highly absorbent and fast drying features.

◀Compact & Easy to Pack▶A·M Cat Turkish beach towel folds up compactly so you can fit several in the trunk, backpack, beach bag or cabinet. Easily stack on small bathroom display shelves or hang on wall-hooks.

◀Multipurpose Use▶ You can use as beach towel, bath towel, pool towel, bath towel, spa towel, gym towel, yoga towel, sauna towel, camping towel, picnic towel, scarf, shawl or blanket. Also turkish towels can be a unique idea for bridesmaid gifts, bachelorette party favors and wedding favors. You can use the big towel as a scarf on the outside, as a shawl on the terminal, as a travel blanket on an airplane, and as beach towels or beach blankets when you get off the plane and go to the beach.

◀Easy to Maintain▶These sandless beach towels can be machine-washed or hand-washed. It will not shrink when washed and dried properly, colors will not fade. Our quick dry towel is recommended to wash in mild cold water and hang it to dry naturally.

◀Customer Service▶You are always welcome to our friendly customer support team for any product issue. We provide e-mail reply within 24 hours. If you have any questions, please feel free to let us know, we will try our best to help you.
